reasons.plausibility: Using a lower thermal load to reduce residual stress in miniature metal components is scientifically sound, though calling it SLS for metals may introduce some uncertainty.

reasons.usefulness: This approach directly addresses the question of mitigating thermal stresses in complex miniature parts and offers a straightforward path for researchers to explore.
